claimChecks.summary: Public discovery and unauthenticated MCP now pass at 3301, but the active Human Web origin at 3300 cannot read the API because credentialed CORS is also pinned to 3301.
The create/redeem/verify/revoke fixture sequence was not started because the authenticated Human surface failed before connection data could load; fixture budget remains 0/4 used.
Viewport reset, exactly-once Browser finalize, bounded raw request window, runtime/database/WorkMesh readback, zero mutation methods, and zero fixture residue pass.

finding.title: Public MCP origin activation breaks credentialed Browser CORS
finding.evidence: The active /agents page at origin 3300 renders Reconnecting and Failed to fetch. OPTIONS from origin 3300 receives Access-Control-Allow-Origin 3301, while origin 3301 is accepted. Source binds CORS, realtime, discovery, and connection URLs to the same WEB_ORIGIN value.
finding.impact: The active Human onboarding surface cannot load authenticated API state, so the required Human plus Agent lifecycle cannot start even though public discovery and MCP routing are healthy.

proposedFollowup.reason: The Browser budget is exhausted and the repair changes the API configuration/service boundary.
minimumRepair: Keep credentialed Browser CORS and realtime headers bound to the exact Web origin http://127.0.0.1:3300.
Introduce a distinct validated public MCP origin bound to http://127.0.0.1:3301 for discovery, connect, MCP, and Skill URLs.
Add focused configuration, CORS, discovery, and agent-connection regression tests plus an API-only versioned activation/rollback contract.
Authorize one additional replacement active Browser attempt only after independent PASS and a fresh exact Human approval.
